items.name: Expansion Backplane
items.depicts: A cyan bus rail holding four magenta card sockets, three populated with vertical expansion boards of varying heights and one left empty.

items.name: Spinning Rust
items.depicts: An open hard-drive chassis with corner mounting screws, a spinning cyan magnetic platter, a white spindle hub, and a magenta-pivoted read/write actuator arm.

items.name: Controller Chip
items.depicts: A magenta-framed black dual-inline integrated circuit with a white pin-one dot and cyan legs, appearing in ten-pin and fourteen-pin widths.

items.name: Twisted Ribbon
items.depicts: A flat cyan parallel ribbon cable with a mid-span twist and an animated pulse gap running along its conductors.

items.name: IRQ Line
items.depicts: A ten-pin magenta-framed controller chip with a cyan status bar and vertical headroom above it for an animated interrupt discharge.

items.name: Pin Socket
items.depicts: A compact black rectangular socket housing nine staggered cyan pins arranged five over four.

items.name: Bulging Caps
items.depicts: Three vertical cyan electrolytic capacitors with white metallic tops and dual lead pins, the middle cylinder slightly shorter.

items.name: Third-Try Plug
items.depicts: A horizontal USB Type-A plug with a magenta cable tail, a white molded grip marked in cyan, and a slotted metal shield.

items.name: PCIe Slot
items.depicts: A horizontal cyan-outlined PCI Express expansion slot with a notched partition, magenta rail, and white contact pins along the bottom.

items.name: DMA Channel
items.depicts: A white perforated transfer track carrying three sliding magenta and cyan data blocks between two cyan endpoints.

items.name: eth0 Card
items.depicts: A cyan-framed network expansion card with a magenta controller die, a white link LED, bottom edge contacts, and a detached black rear bracket.

items.name: Graphics Card
items.depicts: A magenta-shrouded graphics card with twin spinning white-and-cyan cooling fans and a cyan PCIe edge connector underneath.

items.name: Block Device
items.depicts: A compact cyan-framed square drive containing a spinning white magnetic platter, black spindle cross, and diagonal magenta actuator arm.

items.name: Key Matrix
items.depicts: Three staggered rows of white keycaps with cyan undersides, including a wide spacebar on the bottom row.

items.name: COM1 Port
items.depicts: A magenta-shelled nine-pin D-subminiature port with black side mounting ears and nine staggered cyan contacts.

items.name: Jumper Block
items.depicts: A black two-by-five header block of cyan pins with two vertical pairs bridged by magenta plastic shunts.

items.name: Finned Heatsink
items.depicts: Eight tall vertical white cooling fins rising evenly from a solid cyan baseplate.

items.name: Ethernet Jack
items.depicts: A square black modular Ethernet jack with a cyan contact bar inside, a bottom latch cutout, and magenta and cyan status LEDs above.

items.name: Bench Oscilloscope
items.depicts: A black oscilloscope display tracing an animated cyan sine wave across magenta center ticks, flanked by three magenta rotary dials.

items.name: DIP Switch
items.depicts: A magenta six-position DIP switch block with five white toggles flipped up and the third flipped down.

items.name: Binary Blob
items.depicts: A small black storage module streaming cyan data pulses leftward-to-rightward into an eight-pin magenta-framed controller chip.

items.name: PCM Cone
items.depicts: A white loudspeaker cone backed by a cyan driver box, emitting cyan and white sound-wave arcs to the right.

items.name: PS/2 Rodent
items.depicts: A top-down white two-button computer mouse with a cyan cord at the top and a magenta scroll wheel between the buttons.

items.name: Clock Can
items.depicts: A rounded white metallic quartz-crystal oscillator can with a dark face and two cyan leads extending downward.

items.name: SATA Port
items.depicts: A magenta-framed black SATA receptacle containing a cyan horizontal contact blade with a white L-shaped keying tab on the right.

items.name: PWM Four-Pin
items.depicts: A white-bordered black rectangular shroud enclosing four vertical cyan pins.

items.name: Blinkenlights
items.depicts: A narrow magenta circuit strip studded with four alternating cyan and white glowing LEDs.

items.name: NVMe Stick
items.depicts: A horizontal cyan-edged M.2 solid-state drive stick with two magenta NAND flash packages and a white edge-connector end.

items.name: IRQ Mite
items.depicts: A tiny six-by-five-pixel scuttling bug with a white carapace ridge, a cyan or magenta rectangular body, and two white legs centered in a large empty canvas.
